initial_new_cases.description: Two verifier mistakes: observing outer cancellation is not proof that its owned cycle has already retired, and CPython 3.13 frame locals keys return a list for this proxy. Wait for the actual cycle retirement, keep the native save held, and convert the keys to a set. Application semantics were unchanged by these fixture corrections.

first_compiled_verifier.description: The initial save adapter forwarded metadata to FactLedger.store, which does not accept that training callback keyword. The adapter failed before reaching authority. Its empty fact count therefore did not prove revocation enforcement, despite the verifier exiting zero.
first_compiled_verifier.correction: Adapt the callback signature explicitly and require the actual ledger call to raise PermissionError(memory_source_expired_or_deleted), recorded by an event. Rebuild/retest the same application commit; no limit or application source was changed.
